name: Effects gizmo (particles and trail)
summary: Put smoke, sparks, confetti or a splash anywhere, or hang a glowing trail on a hand or a prop. Play it once, loop it, or stop it, and a beat can start it too.
helps: Add a burst of confetti at a reveal, sparks on a hit, or a comet trail on a wand, gently and without flashing.
where2d: Atelier and BSA, right panel, Gizmos: Effects.

d2: Open the right panel, find Gizmos, and press Add next to Effects.
Press Preset until it says Confetti, then press Play once.
Press Loop to keep it going, and Stop to clear it.
Press the Tab row to switch to Trail, then Follow to pick a hand or a prop.
vr: Open the wrist menu and press Objects, then Gizmos, then Effects. Put it down.
Turn Gizmos live on, then tap the effect and press Play once or Loop.
use: nothing plays when a scene opens or while Gizmos live is off
everything fades slowly and the colours glide, so it never flashes
there is a limit of 600 particles across all your effects
a beat can start or stop an effect
hiding gizmos hides the box and the effect keeps playing.

changes.note: You can now add an Effects gizmo that plays smoke, sparks, confetti or a trail, so add one from Gizmos, choose a preset, then press Play once, Loop or Stop.
